subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should `agents_list` expose operator-authored agent descriptions to every requester already authorized to discover and spawn that agent, and what normalization and length limit should form the permanent contract?
rationale: The config field already exists, but exposing arbitrary authored text in model-visible discovery output affects prompt size and the trust boundary; code inspection alone cannot choose that permanent policy.

options.title: Expose bounded descriptions
options.body: Return trimmed, nonblank descriptions only for already-authorized agents, enforce a documented maximum length, and cover authorization and omission behavior.

options.title: Keep descriptions config-only
options.body: Do not expose the field through `agents_list`, and close the linked implementation PR after documenting that descriptions are administrative metadata only.

options.title: Use a privileged metadata surface
options.body: Keep `agents_list` minimal and expose descriptive metadata through a separate explicitly privileged discovery API or tool.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded descriptions
recommendation.body: Return trimmed, nonblank descriptions only for already-authorized agents, enforce a documented maximum length, and cover authorization and omission behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this person most directly to the original discovery tool and multi-agent config/routing contract, and repository documentation identifies them as the project lead.
